{{Top}} {{Otheruses|Lina}} {{Character |type= |image=Lina Storypad 1 - This Could Be a Real Adventure.jpg |name=Lina |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species= |gender= |pronouns=She/her{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}} |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin= |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation= |masters= |apprentices= }} '''Lina''' was a fictional [[Jedi]] character who appeared in a story that [[Wim]] read on his [[storypad]]. ==Biography== Lina's tale was written in [[Aurebesh]] and went: [[File:Lina Storypad 2 - This Could Be a Real Adventure.jpg|thumb|220px|right|Lina dueling a [[Sith]] in the [[Cave of Shadows (fictional)|Cave of Shadows]]]] {{ExcerptIU|THE CAVE OF
SHADOWS WAS DARK AND OMINOUS, BUT
LINA WAS NOT
AFRAID. SHE IGNITED HER LIGHTSABER, IT'S ''[sic]''
BLUE GLOW LIGHTING
UP THE DARKNESS.
READY FOR WHAT
LAY AHEAD. SUDDENLY, THE SITH APPEARED BEFORE
HER, IN DARK ROBES AND A RED LIGHT SABER ''[sic]''.
"YOU SHOULD NOT HAVE COME HERE," HE HISSED,
HIS VOICE ECHOED THROUGH THE CAVE}} ==Appearances== *{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}} {{1st}} {{C|Appears on storypad}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Lina (Jedi) |ja=リナ |ka=ლინა (ჯედაი) }} [[Category:Fictional characters]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]]
